skill.summary: Run DiffDock molecular docking via NVIDIA NIM to predict small-molecule binding poses against protein targets. Use for DiffDock, molecular docking, ligand docking, blind docking, SMILES or SDF ligands, ranked poses, confidence scores, hosted NVIDIA API, or local Docker deployment.

review.exception_reason: Preserve the upstream per-Skill combined Apache-2.0/CC-BY-4.0 declaration. The same pinned NVIDIA commit supplies LICENSE, LICENSE-APACHE-2.0, LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0 and NOTICE; retain all four documents, attribution, source link and unmodified payload bytes in the distributed package. This review accepts the combined expression for this package only; it does not change the default allowlist or license external NIM services, model weights or user data. Bundled PDB fixtures match the official RCSB downloads byte-for-byte (1M17 or 1R42); PDB archive data are CC0 under https://www.wwpdb.org/about/usage-policies. Their original headers and attribution remain intact.
